name.description: Who is on screen (empty: the bar shows no name).

title.description: A short line under the name.

cover.description: The area to hide (the printed names), in fractions of the picture from its top-left. Default: the bottom-left corner where call apps print names.

style.description: band (default): across the whole picture; tab: a box only as wide as the area and the name.

hide.description: Take the bar away (footage with nothing to cover); a later change brings it back.

logo.description: A small logo at the start of the bar.

firstNames.description: The names are first names only (a conversation's tile tags follow it).

height.description: full (default) or half: about half as tall, never too short to cover the printed names.

animate.description: How a name comes in: fade (default), slide or never (nothing moves). The bar is always solid from its first frame.
